SELECT
  "public"."facility_facility"."external_id" AS "Facility ID",
  "public"."facility_facility"."name" AS "Facility Name",
  "Emr Organization - Geo Organization"."name" AS "Geo Organization"
FROM
  "public"."facility_facility"
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'cache_expiry' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: timestamp AS "cached_parent_json → cache_expiry",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'id' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → id",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'level_cache' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: decimal AS "cached_parent_json → level_cache",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'name' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → name",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'org_type' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → org_type",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'cache_expiry' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: timestamp AS "cached_parent_json → parent → cache_expiry",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'id' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → id",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'level_cache' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: decimal AS "cached_parent_json → parent → level_cache",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'name' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → name",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'org_type' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → org_type",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'cache_expiry' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: timestamp AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → cache_expiry",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'id' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → id",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'level_cache' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: decimal AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → level_cache",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'name' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → name",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'org_type' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → org_type",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (
          array [ 'parent',
          'parent',
          'parent',
          'cache_expiry' ] :: text [ ]
        )
      ) :: timestamp AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → parent_970d0781",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'parent', 'id' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → parent → id",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (
          array [ 'parent',
          'parent',
          'parent',
          'level_cache' ] :: text [ ]
        )
      ) :: decimal AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → parent_84943ece",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (array [ 'parent', 'parent', 'parent', 'name' ] :: text [ ])
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → parent → name",
      (
        "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" #>> (
          array [ 'parent',
          'parent',
          'parent',
          'org_type' ] :: text [ ]
        )
      ) :: text AS "cached_parent_json → parent → parent → parent_7d4b0494",
      "public"."emr_organization"."id" AS "id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."external_id" AS "external_id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."created_date" AS "created_date",
      "public"."emr_organization"."modified_date" AS "modified_date",
      "public"."emr_organization"."deleted" AS "deleted",
      "public"."emr_organization"."history" AS "history",
      "public"."emr_organization"."meta" AS "meta",
      "public"."emr_organization"."active" AS "active",
      "public"."emr_organization"."org_type" AS "org_type",
      "public"."emr_organization"."name" AS "name",
      "public"."emr_organization"."has_children" AS "has_children",
      "public"."emr_organization"."description" AS "description",
      "public"."emr_organization"."system_generated" AS "system_generated",
      "public"."emr_organization"."level_cache" AS "level_cache",
      "public"."emr_organization"."parent_cache" AS "parent_cache",
      "public"."emr_organization"."metadata" AS "metadata",
      "public"."emr_organization"."cached_parent_json" AS "cached_parent_json",
      "public"."emr_organization"."created_by_id" AS "created_by_id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."parent_id" AS "parent_id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."root_org_id" AS "root_org_id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."updated_by_id" AS "updated_by_id",
      "public"."emr_organization"."managing_organizations" AS "managing_organizations"
    FROM
      "public"."emr_organization"
  ) AS "Emr Organization - Geo Organization" ON "public"."facility_facility"."geo_organization_id" = "Emr Organization - Geo Organization"."id"
WHERE
  ("public"."facility_facility"."is_public" = TRUE)
  AND ("public"."facility_facility"."deleted" = FALSE)
  AND ("public"."facility_facility"."is_active" = TRUE)
  [[AND "public"."facility_facility"."external_id" = CAST({{facility_id}} AS UUID)]]

SELECT
  (
    '****-****-****-' || RIGHT(f.external_id::TEXT, 4)
  ) AS "facilityCode",
  f.name AS "facilityName",
  COUNT(DISTINCT loc.id) FILTER (
    WHERE
      hs.id IS NOT NULL
  ) AS "totalDDCCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT loc.id) FILTER (
    WHERE
      hs.id IS NOT NULL
      AND loc.status = 'active'
  ) AS "activeDDCCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT loc.id) FILTER (
    WHERE
      hs.id IS NOT NULL
      AND loc.status != 'active'
  ) AS "inactiveDDCCount"
FROM
  facility_facility f
  LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.facility_id = f.id
  AND loc.deleted = FALSE
  LEFT JOIN emr_healthcareservice hs ON loc.id = ANY (hs.locations)
  AND hs.deleted = FALSE
  AND hs.internal_type = 'pharmacy'
WHERE
  f.deleted = FALSE
  AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
GROUP BY
  f.external_id,
  f.name
ORDER BY
  f.name;

WITH
  p AS (
    SELECT
      CASE LOWER(TRIM({{issue_date}}))
        WHEN 'today' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
        WHEN 'yesterday' THEN (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1
        ELSE {{issue_date}}::date
      END AS d
  )
SELECT
  loc.name AS "STORE_NAME",
  dvdms.eaushadhi_issue_no AS "HSTNUM_ISSUE_NO",
  dvdms.drug_id AS "HSTNUM_ITEM_ID",
  dvdms.brand_id AS "HSTNUM_ITEMBRAND_ID",
  COALESCE(dvdms.batch, p2.batch ->> 'lot_number') AS "HSTSTR_BATCH_SL_NO",
  md.quantity AS "HSTNUM_ISSUE_QTY",
  COALESCE(
    dvdms.expiry_date,
    (p2.expiration_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
  ) AS "HSTDT_EXPIRY_DATE",
  pat.external_id AS "HRGNUM_PUK"
FROM
  p,
  emr_medicationdispense md
  JOIN emr_facilitylocation loc ON loc.id = md.location_id
  JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = loc.facility_id
  JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
  JOIN emr_product p2 ON p2.id = ii.product_id
  JOIN emr_patient pat ON pat.id = md.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      ir.eaushadhi_issue_no,
      d.drug_id,
      d.brand_id,
      iir.batch,
      iir.expiry_date
    FROM
      emr_supplydelivery sd
      JOIN emr_inventoryitem sii ON sii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorddelivery rd ON rd.delivery_order_id = sd.order_id
      AND rd.deleted = FALSE
      AND rd.status <> 'cancelled'
      JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwardrecord ir ON ir.id = rd.inward_record_id
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemdelivery rid ON rid.supply_delivery_id = sd.id
      AND rid.record_delivery_id = rd.id
      AND rid.deleted = FALSE
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwarditemrecord iir ON iir.id = rid.inward_record_item_id
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemorder rio ON rio.id = iir.record_order_item_id
      LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d ON d.id = rio.drug_id
    WHERE
      sii.product_id = ii.product_id
      AND sd.status = 'completed'
      AND sd.deleted = FALSE
      AND sd.created_date <= COALESCE(
        md.when_handed_over,
        md.when_prepared,
        md.created_date
      )
    ORDER BY
      sd.created_date DESC
    LIMIT
      1
  ) dvdms ON TRUE
WHERE
  md.deleted = FALSE
  AND md.status = 'completed'
  AND f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
  AND (
    COALESCE(
      md.when_handed_over,
      md.when_prepared,
      md.created_date
    ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
  )::date = p.d
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(
    md.when_handed_over,
    md.when_prepared,
    md.created_date
  ),
  "HSTNUM_ISSUE_NO";

WITH
   pharmacy_stores AS (
     SELECT
       loc.id AS location_id
     FROM
       emr_facilitylocation loc
       JOIN emr_healthcareservice hs ON loc.id = ANY (hs.locations)
       AND hs.deleted = FALSE
       AND hs.internal_type = 'pharmacy'
     WHERE
       loc.deleted = FALSE
   ),
   eaushadhi_drugs AS (
     SELECT DISTINCT ON (ii.product_id)
       ii.product_id,
       d.drug_id,
       d.name AS drug_name,
       ir.eaushadhi_issue_no
     FROM
       care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorditemorder rio
       JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecordorder ro ON ro.id = rio.record_order_id
       AND ro.deleted = FALSE
       AND ro.status <> 'cancelled'
       JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsdrug d ON d.id = rio.drug_id
       JOIN emr_supplydelivery sd ON sd.supply_request_id = rio.supply_request_id
       AND sd.deleted = FALSE
       JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
       LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsrecorddelivery rd ON rd.delivery_order_id = sd.order_id
       AND rd.deleted = FALSE
       AND rd.status <> 'cancelled'
       LEFT JOIN care_dvdms_dvdmsinwardrecord ir ON ir.id = rd.inward_record_id
     WHERE
       rio.deleted = FALSE
     ORDER BY
       ii.product_id,
       sd.created_date DESC
   ),
   movements AS (
     SELECT
       dor.origin_id AS from_location_id,
       dor.destination_id AS to_location_id,
       ii.product_id,
       sd.created_date::date AS metric_date,
       CASE
         WHEN dor.origin_id IS NOT NULL THEN sd.supplied_item_quantity
         ELSE 0
       END AS quantity_issued,
       sd.supplied_item_quantity AS quantity_consumed
     FROM
       emr_supplydelivery sd
       JOIN emr_deliveryorder dor ON dor.id = sd.order_id
       AND dor.deleted = FALSE
       JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = sd.supplied_inventory_item_id
     WHERE
       sd.deleted = FALSE
       AND sd.status = 'completed'
     UNION ALL
     SELECT
       ii.location_id AS from_location_id,
       NULL AS to_location_id,
       ii.product_id,
       COALESCE(md.when_handed_over, md.when_prepared, md.created_date)::date AS metric_date,
       md.quantity AS quantity_issued,
       0 AS quantity_consumed
     FROM
       emr_medicationdispense md
       JOIN emr_inventoryitem ii ON ii.id = md.item_id
     WHERE
       md.deleted = FALSE
       AND md.status = 'completed'
   )
 SELECT
   COALESCE(fl.name, '-') AS from_store,
   COALESCE(tl.name, '-') AS to_store,
   ed.drug_id,
   ed.drug_name,
   p.batch ->> 'lot_number' AS batch_number,
   (p.expiration_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS expiry_date,
   ed.eaushadhi_issue_no AS issue_no,
   m.metric_date,
   SUM(m.quantity_issued) AS total_quantity_issued,
   SUM(m.quantity_consumed) AS total_quantity_consumed
 FROM
   movements m
   JOIN emr_product p ON p.id = m.product_id
   LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation fl ON fl.id = m.from_location_id
   LEFT JOIN emr_facilitylocation tl ON tl.id = m.to_location_id
   JOIN facility_facility f ON f.id = COALESCE(fl.facility_id, tl.facility_id)
   LEFT JOIN eaushadhi_drugs ed ON ed.product_id = m.product_id
 WHERE
   f.external_id = {{facility_id}}::UUID
   AND m.metric_date = {{issue_date}}::date
   AND (
     m.from_location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM pharmacy_stores)
     OR m.to_location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM pharmacy_stores)
   )
 GROUP BY
   fl.name,
   tl.name,
   p.id,
   ed.drug_id,
   ed.drug_name,
   ed.eaushadhi_issue_no,
   m.metric_date
 ORDER BY
   from_store,
   to_store,
   drug_name,
   batch_number;
